title: 500m Extraction Map - Detailed Godot Blockout Plan
status: DESIGN PROPOSAL (not an existing game scene)

zones.name: Town Core
zones.role: High-density urban combat and central loot hub
zones.combat_profile: Close to medium; alleys and two-storey sightlines
zones.implementation_notes: Keep 6m main road open; interconnect at least 3 alley routes across blocks. Interiors only for tagged buildings.

zones.name: Industry / Rail Yard
zones.role: Medium-range industrial combat and eastern route to E-B
zones.combat_profile: Mid to long lanes, hard cover from freight cars and containers
zones.implementation_notes: Do not place collision on rail crossing of county road; use 8m cargo lanes.

zones.name: Military Bunker
zones.role: High-risk secured compound, optional underground entrance
zones.combat_profile: Close-range compound; strong choke at south gate
zones.implementation_notes: Build underground as separate scene stub; exterior compound and gate first.

zones.name: Hills
zones.combat_profile: Long sightlines broken by boulders and tree stands
zones.implementation_notes: Use gentle stepped terrain blockout, max practical walkable slope 30 degrees.

zones.name: Forest and Greenbelt
zones.role: Concealed flanking route west of rail yard and NE extract approach
zones.combat_profile: Short intermittent sightlines with tree/log cover
zones.implementation_notes: Keep a 4m cleared hiking trail to E-A; preserve 6m buffer around river.

zones.name: West and South Farmland
zones.role: Spawn approach with alternating exposed fields and farm structures
zones.combat_profile: Medium to long with hedges, crop rows, bale cover
zones.implementation_notes: S1 and S2 need initial safe cover and 18m no-loot spawn clearance.

zones.name: River / Crossings
zones.role: Natural separator; defines bridge and secondary crossing
zones.combat_profile: Bridge medium-long; fords close, high exposure
zones.implementation_notes: All water is non-walkable except explicit shallow-ford path; river path must connect into lake.

zones.name: Lake Shore
zones.role: Exposed final shoreline route and E-C extract
zones.implementation_notes: Accessible shore only, no deep-water traversals; make E-C extract at shoreline on dry ground.

structures.name: Bunker entrance portal
structures.notes: Portal leads to a separate underground scene; locked door placeholder, no invented underground plan.

structures.name: South gate security
structures.notes: Only driveable gate on existing gravel road (x=127,y=144).

structures.name: Main county-road bridge
structures.notes: Passable deck, 8-9m wide. No blocking collision; guardrails at edges only.

structures.name: Northern shallow ford
structures.notes: Slow traversal; shallow water only in marked 12m strip.

structures.name: Southern fallen-log crossing
structures.notes: Single-file noisy foot crossing; alternative to road bridge.

structures.name: Weathered boat dock
structures.notes: Allow partial water overlap, floor navigable but water below nonwalkable.

corridors.name: County road east-west
corridors.rule: keep open, car cover only on shoulders

corridors.name: Bunker access gravel
corridors.rule: south gate must align with route

corridors.name: Railway right-of-way
corridors.rule: mark level crossing at road; rails can be crossed by foot

corridors.name: Town south alley
corridors.rule: weave east of apartment, west of civic block

cover_clusters.rule: outside 8m county road clear lane: position on shoulders only
irregular intermittent cover, not full walls
stay on shoreline, no solid cover blocking E-C

vegetation.implementation: use instancing or MultiMesh for trees; no mesh details required for first blockout

points.name: West fields, south
points.rules: Spawn safe area: no initial line of sight from other spawns, no loot placement inside 18 m.

points.name: West fields, north
points.rules: Spawn safe area: no initial line of sight from other spawns, no loot placement inside 18 m.

points.name: Northeast forest exit
points.rules: Keep navigation clear and mark extraction trigger.

points.name: Southeast rail service exit
points.rules: Keep navigation clear and mark extraction trigger.

points.name: Lake shore exit
points.rules: Keep navigation clear and mark extraction trigger.

points.name: Northwest perimeter exit
points.rules: Keep navigation clear and mark extraction trigger; E-D may be conditional to avoid low-risk early exit.

ai_placement_rules.patrol_paths: Prefer baked waypoints per POI, not arbitrary wander through map obstacles
ai_placement_rules.enemy_spawns: No enemy within 35m of S1/S2; no direct line of sight into spawn on initial match start.
ai_placement_rules.combat: Use zone tags (close/medium/long) to tune behavior, not hardcoded AI per mesh.
ai_placement_rules.navmesh: Baked per chunk after graybox placement; maintain all intended crossings.
ai_placement_rules.performance: Use modular proxies, MultiMesh vegetation, sparse visible physics, occluders near town/industry, no per-prop scripts.

design_risks: Eastern exits E-B and E-C are close; give them different extract requirements or approach hazards.
E-D in northwest is on same side as both western spawns; consider a conditional extract with quest/key/timer.
River choke can cause repeated bridge camping: maintain shallow northern ford and southern log crossing.
All added locations and loot are proposals, not in the original sketch.
